{{jbocre/en}}
According to [[The Book]], the place structure of PA + va'e is:
{{gl|PA + va'e|x1 is at scale position (n) on the scale x2}}

unless the PA is one of the subjective numbers (du'e, rau or mo'a).  In which case the place structure is:
{{gl|PA + va'e|x1 is at scale position (n) on the scale x2 by standard x3}}

==Discussion==
{{mu|le vi rozgu cu pibi<u>va'e</u> le ka ce'u xunre|This rose is very red.|This rose is .8 on the scale of redness.}}
{{mu|mi piso'u<u>va'e</u> le ka ce'u krici la'e di'u|I barely believe it.|I am very little on the scale of beieving that.}}

{{mu|la'e di'u piso'u'''va'e''' le ka mi krici ce'u|I barely believe it.|That is very little on the scale of being believed by me.}}

{{mu|le nu mi krici la'e di'u cu piso'u'''va'e''' le ka ce'u fasnu|I barely believe it.|My believing it is very little on the scale of occurring.}}

{{mu|le du'u mi krici la'e di'u cu piso'u'''va'e''' le ka ce'u fatci|I barely believe it.|That I believe it is very little on the scale of being a fact.}}

Is this how it is supposed to be used?
